evidence.quote: The field \"primary.key.mode\" should have dots/periods ... since you've omitted the dots/periods, the connector defaults to primary key mode \"none\" ... \"pk.mode\" and \"pk.fields\" are not valid configurations for Debezium

notes: Deletes failed because of misspelled property names and values ('record key'), and Confluent pk.* properties were used. With message.key.columns and primary.key.mode=record_key it works.
